answer: The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, re-queued for a second panel, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the cipher of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Every claim climbs the mesa of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the garden re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
